elements.text: Charge the battery indoors at room temperature. A full charge takes about 5 hours with the standard charger. You can charge the battery on or off the bike.
The display shows speed, assistance level, and battery charge. A blinking battery icon means the charge is low; charge soon.
Eco gives the longest range. Tour balances range and support. Boost gives the most support for hills and uses the battery fastest.
Store the battery indoors at about 50 percent charge. Check it every two months and top it up if it falls below 30 percent.
Clean the bike with a damp cloth. Never use a pressure washer: water can enter the motor and the battery contacts.
